Swiss Army Bench 0.0.35

- **Updates are looked for every 30 minutes** (it was every six hours), so a new release shows its "Click here to
  update" in Settings soon after it is out.
- **The grid's corner is Select all alone.** The switch that shows or hides the column profiles in the headers moved
  to the Column row: Profiles in headers (pressed while they show; remembered).
- **Deleted and removed projects stay gone.** On Windows one folder can be written several ways (capital letters,
  `\` or `/`, a slash at the end); a project opened under two spellings showed twice and came back after Remove or
  Delete. Now one folder is one card, and Remove or Delete takes every spelling off, in the local and the shared
  projects folders alike.
